authority: Tom — ③ Unfreeze GO. Factory payloads exist. KEY utilization validation only.
note: Measures KEY utilization (used / honest_absence / disconnect / misuse) — NOT Gap engine accuracy or Recommendation algorithm quality.

purpose.measures: KEY utilization of existing Factory evidence (Coverage Gap, Underwriting, Recommendation, Memory)
purpose.tom_boundary: When factory data exists → use it. When absent → honest 'do not know'. This boundary builds KEY trust.

merge_gate.rule: Tom freeze → Preview baseline → per-axis observation → Tom Audit

questions.question: 전에 보험료 부담 얘기했던 거 기억나?

questions.question: 지난번 상담 기억해?

questions.question: 예전에 말한 걱정 아직 유효한지 봐줘.

questions.question: 암 보장 괜찮아?

questions.question: 뭐가 빠져 있는지 알려줘.
